services.desc: Payments can be made in the form of a check, cash, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, or American Express. A deposit of 50% is required to reserve your fishing charter, with the remaining balance due upon the completion of the trip. See Cancellation Policy below. Half Day Newport Fishing Charters - 8:00 a.m. - 12:00 p.m. or 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. Come ‘Tog fishing with experts using our new Minn Kota Instinct trolling motor (“spot lock”) with auto stow and deploy. This increased accuracy keeps us on the hot spot so you can reel in more!
